newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dollar dip sparks some demand for European feeds.
newsitem.headline: Dollar dip sparks some demand for European feeds.

text.p: A dip in the dollar boosted demand on the European meals and feeds market at firmer levels this afternoon, market sources said.

"Most of the business done was for nearby mid-protein material on the easier dollar. A sharply higher soymeal market discouraged buyers in that product and kept trade restricted to afloat material," one broker said.
Afloat Argentine soymeal pellets traded $3.50 up at $307 a tonne cif Rotterdam.
Afloat Argentine sunmeal pellets traded at $136 a tonne cif Rotterdam, March up $1 at $130.50 and March/June at $128.50 cif.
